title: LetMeShowYouSomething — History (the earlier rounds)
description: #82 — the earlier rounds of a continuing review, oldest first, as the page carries them. Each round keeps its review and the reviewer's feedback exactly as they were: a review.v1 and a feedback.v1, never rewritten. The current round is the review the page shows. Unsigned: a history says what the files say, it proves nothing about who answered or when.
